sources.elementary: Elementary definitions and arithmetic independently worked by the author; no original MMMU gold or explanation used. Formal checks verify computations, not empirical knowledge or clinical truth.

knowledge_Music_K1_01.rationale: A perfect fifth spans seven semitones in twelve-tone equal temperament.

knowledge_Music_K2_01.rationale: F,G,A,B,C span five letter names; natural F4 to natural C5 spans seven semitones.

knowledge_Music_K1_02.rationale: A quarter note is two ordinary eighth-note durations.

knowledge_Music_K2_02.rationale: A 3/4 measure lasts six eighths. The given notes occupy four eighths, leaving two eighths, a quarter note.

knowledge_Electronics_K1_01.rationale: An ideal capacitor carries no current when its voltage is constant after DC transients end.

knowledge_Electronics_K2_01.rationale: The capacitor interrupts the only ideal steady-state DC current path.
knowledge_Electronics_K2_01.check: Steady capacitor voltage is constant, so the sole series-loop current is zero.

knowledge_Electronics_K1_02.rationale: Both parallel resistors have the same voltage; their currents add.

knowledge_Materials_K1_01.rationale: Average normal stress on the perpendicular section is axial force per cross-sectional area.
knowledge_Materials_K1_01.check: Force/area has stress units; centered axial loading excludes bending.

knowledge_Materials_K2_01.rationale: 900/30=30 N/mm^2; one N/mm^2 equals one MPa.

knowledge_Materials_K1_02.rationale: Engineering strain uses extension divided by original length.
knowledge_Materials_K1_02.check: The original, not final, length is the engineering-strain denominator.

knowledge_Materials_K2_02.rationale: The extension is 0.16 mm and the original length is 80 mm.

knowledge_Computer_Science_K1_01.rationale: A complete DFA's transition function maps every state-symbol pair to one state.
knowledge_Computer_Science_K1_01.check: Completeness excludes zero; determinism excludes two or more.

knowledge_Computer_Science_K2_01.rationale: Each x toggles the state and y preserves it. The input has three x symbols.

knowledge_Computer_Science_K1_02.rationale: Unit-step linear probing visits the next slot with wraparound.
knowledge_Computer_Science_K1_02.check: Successive probe indices differ by one modulo table length.

knowledge_Computer_Science_K2_02.rationale: All three hashes are 3; 10 takes slot 3, 17 takes slot 4, and 24 takes slot 5.

knowledge_Biology_K1_01.rationale: Ordinary DNA has complementary A-T and G-C base pairs.
knowledge_Biology_K1_01.check: Uracil is not the ordinary DNA adenine partner.

knowledge_Biology_K2_01.rationale: Apply A->T, G->C, T->A, C->G at aligned antiparallel positions.
knowledge_Biology_K2_01.check: AGTC translates to TCAG when complementary positions are written 3' to 5'.

knowledge_Biology_K1_02.rationale: The fully penetrant recessive phenotype requires two recessive alleles under the stipulated simple model.
knowledge_Biology_K1_02.check: AA and Aa each have a dominant A allele.

knowledge_Biology_K2_02.rationale: Each parent transmits a with probability one-half. Both a transmissions are needed.

knowledge_Accounting_K1_01.rationale: Available raw materials either remain at period end or were used, absent other adjustments.

knowledge_Accounting_K2_01.rationale: Materials used are beginning stock plus purchases less ending stock.

knowledge_Accounting_K1_02.answer_text: Collecting a customer's receivable in cash
knowledge_Accounting_K1_02.rationale: Collection brings in cash; payment removes cash, while credit purchase and depreciation do not themselves move cash.
knowledge_Accounting_K1_02.check: Only the collection option is an immediate cash inflow.

knowledge_Accounting_K2_02.rationale: Only the receipt and cash payment change the cash balance; the credit purchase does not.

knowledge_Physics_K1_01.rationale: Integrating signed velocity over time gives signed position change; absolute areas give distance.

knowledge_Physics_K2_01.rationale: The two signed displacements are +12 m and -6 m.

knowledge_Physics_K1_02.rationale: Newton's second law for constant mass in an inertial frame equates net force and mass times acceleration.

knowledge_Physics_K2_02.rationale: The net force is 6 N rightward, divided by mass 3 kg.

knowledge_Public_Health_K1_01.rationale: Specificity is the proportion of disease-absent people correctly classified negative.

knowledge_Public_Health_K2_01.rationale: Among the 100 disease-absent people, 90 test negative.

knowledge_Public_Health_K1_02.answer_text: New cases / disease-free people at the start
knowledge_Public_Health_K1_02.rationale: Incidence proportion uses new first onsets over the initially disease-free population at risk.
knowledge_Public_Health_K1_02.check: This is a proportion over a fixed period, not a person-time incidence rate.

knowledge_Public_Health_K2_02.rationale: Twelve first onsets among 120 initially disease-free people give one-tenth.

knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.rationale: Hyperplasia denotes increased cell number; hypertrophy denotes increased individual cell size.
The stipulated change doubles cell number without changing individual cell volume or type.
knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.check: 2000>1000; individual volume unchanged; category is increased cell number.

knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.answer_text: Cell shrinkage with membrane-bound cellular fragments
knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.rationale: Classical apoptosis has cell shrinkage and membrane-bound fragments; early lytic necrosis is associated with membrane disruption.
knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.check: Restricted to introductory classical morphology, not every regulated cell-death subtype.

knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.rationale: The supplied shrinkage, chromatin condensation, and contained fragmentation form the classical apoptotic pattern.
knowledge_Diagnostics_and_Laboratory_Med.check: No patient diagnosis or etiology is inferred; only a stipulated basic morphology category.

knowledge_Architecture_and_Engineering_K.rationale: At 1:n, one plan unit represents n ground units.
knowledge_Architecture_and_Engineering_K.check: Ground/plan length ratio=n for consistent units.

knowledge_Architecture_and_Engineering_K.rationale: Four centimeters times 2,500 is 10,000 centimeters, or 100 meters.
Center spacing equals ground-footprint length minus the overlap length pL.
The overlapping length is 300 m, so equal footprint centers are separated by 200 m.

knowledge_Mechanical_Engineering_K1_01.rationale: Moment magnitude is force multiplied by the perpendicular distance to its line of action.

knowledge_Mechanical_Engineering_K2_01.rationale: The end force is perpendicular, so the full 0.25 m is the moment arm.

knowledge_Mechanical_Engineering_K1_02.rationale: Stored energy is the integral of the linear spring force k*x from zero deformation to x.
knowledge_Mechanical_Engineering_K1_02.check: Integral from 0 to x of k*s ds=(1/2)*k*x^2.

knowledge_Mechanical_Engineering_K2_02.rationale: Energy is one-half times stiffness times compression squared.

knowledge_Geography_K1_01.answer_text: Vertical elevation difference between adjacent contour levels
knowledge_Geography_K1_01.rationale: The contour interval is the elevation increment represented by consecutive contour levels.
knowledge_Geography_K1_01.check: It describes vertical elevation, not horizontal drawing spacing.

knowledge_Geography_K2_01.rationale: Both differences between the stated consecutive levels are 25 m.

knowledge_Geography_K1_02.rationale: Latitude measures angular position north or south from the equator.
knowledge_Geography_K1_02.check: The prime meridian defines zero longitude, not latitude.

knowledge_Geography_K2_02.rationale: The smallest absolute latitude is five degrees.

knowledge_Chemistry_K1_01.answer_text: Moles of solute / liters of solution
knowledge_Chemistry_K1_01.rationale: Molar concentration uses total solution volume rather than pure solvent volume.
knowledge_Chemistry_K1_01.check: Molar concentration unit is mol/L of solution.

knowledge_Chemistry_K2_01.rationale: Divide the solute amount by the final solution volume.

knowledge_Chemistry_K1_02.rationale: Oxidation numbers sum to zero for a neutral species and to net charge for an ion.
knowledge_Chemistry_K1_02.check: The ion is explicitly charged, so an always-zero rule is false.

knowledge_Chemistry_K2_02.rationale: Four oxygen atoms contribute -8 and the ion has total charge -2, requiring sulfur +6.

knowledge_Math_K1_01.rationale: An everywhere positive second derivative makes the slope strictly increasing and the function strictly convex on the interval.
knowledge_Math_K1_01.check: Strict positivity is stronger than the nonnegative-second-derivative convexity condition.

knowledge_Math_K2_01.rationale: The second derivative of this quadratic is the positive constant 6.

knowledge_Math_K1_02.rationale: A graph isomorphism preserves adjacency and therefore the number of incident edges at corresponding vertices.
knowledge_Math_K1_02.check: Names, drawing coordinates, and edge-list order do not define abstract graph structure.

knowledge_Math_K2_02.answer_text: They are not isomorphic: G has a degree-3 vertex and H does not
knowledge_Math_K2_02.rationale: G is a four-vertex star with degrees 3,1,1,1; H is a path with degrees 2,2,1,1.

knowledge_Energy_and_Power_K1_01.rationale: With entering heat positive and work done by the system positive, work removes energy from the closed system.
knowledge_Energy_and_Power_K1_01.check: Bulk kinetic/potential changes are excluded, so Delta U=Q-W.

knowledge_Energy_and_Power_K2_01.rationale: Heat adds 350 J and outgoing work removes 120 J.

knowledge_Energy_and_Power_K1_02.rationale: Raising each kilogram adds potential energy g*h; multiplying by kilograms per second gives power.

knowledge_Energy_and_Power_K2_02.rationale: The device adds gravitational potential energy at a rate of 2*10*5 joules per second.
